status: preregistered; confirmatory outcomes not inspected; integration not authorized by a passing result yet
scope: Engineering acceptance for a receptor-supported experimental drawing candidate. Numeric margins are project decisions fixed before new holdout outcomes, not published biological standards.
decision_rule: ALL biological, assumption-bridge, anatomical and isolation requirements must pass before candidate motor training; ALL subsequent motor checks must pass before candidate can be enabled. Missing evidence is pending/inconclusive, never implicitly passed.

development: hook_flexion_01_treadmill_platform.parquet: all animals, including previously evaluated test animals
hook_flexion_01_magnet.parquet: all animals, including previously evaluated passive transfer animals
known_exposure.rule: Previously inspected results may inform development but cannot be advertised as fresh confirmatory evidence. Record any additional outcome exposure before executing final evaluation.

primary.animals: all8 animals established by metadata-only inspection
primary.conditions: all eligible observations; active and not-actively-moving strata additionally reported without selective exclusion

passive.role: fresh passive transfer; no per-animal refitting
passive.historical_limit: These outcomes were not inspected during our model selection, but the published calcium-kernel prior was historically tuned on Mamiya data. This is not completely independent of all prior model knowledge.

confirmatory_data.identity_rule: Audit cohort provenance for biological animal overlap. Numeric animal IDs reused across files do not establish either biological identity or independence.
confirmatory_data.eligibility: At least30 finite analyze=1 scored observations per animal under the locked preprocessing; report all exclusions. Fewer eligible animals yields inconclusive.
confirmatory_data.outcome_access: Metadata/schema/IDs/checksums may be checked before model lock. Calcium outcomes, derived predictions and scoring remain sealed until the lock manifest exists.

development_protocol.validation: Animal-grouped cross-validation on development data only; preprocessing, calcium kernel/calibration, candidate selection and parameters all fitted within each training fold.
development_protocol.comparison: Choose strongest comparator by development animal-grouped cross-validation among passive-derived nongated, constant, v1-style and movement-only release models. Freeze selection before reserved outcomes. The new tonic-release candidate must beat movement-only control; behavior recognition alone does not establish sensory-transmission value.
lock_before_confirmatory: eligible cohort/animal IDs and preprocessing policy
candidate and comparator parameters and model SHA256 values
all random seeds and bootstrap protocol
development_protocol.evaluation: Run once after freezing both models. No outcome-based exclusions, threshold edits, model reselection, per-animal test amplitude fitting or test-set normalization fitting.
development_protocol.failure_policy: A failed/inconclusive new holdout cannot become a tuning set and then be reused for confirmation. A new protocol version requires new untouched confirmatory observations.
development_protocol.passive_comparison: Freeze passive observation head and development-fitted constant and matched nongated comparators before test. At gate-off the matched nongated model may be identical: noninferiority alone is then not evidence of predictive value.

metrics.animal_mse: Mean squared calcium prediction error over scored frames for each animal; combine trials/ROIs within animal without treating frames as independent animals.
metrics.cohort_mse: Arithmetic mean of animal MSE values, equal animal weight.
metrics.near_zero_baseline: If cohort baseline MSE<=epsilon, relative improvement is not identified: mark inconclusive instead of exploiting a tiny denominator.

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap of biological animals, resampling identical indices for gated/baseline MSE; recompute cohort ratio for every replicate
uncertainty.interval: two-sided percentile95%; not a frame-level bootstrap
uncertainty.zero_denominator_replicate: Mark interval inconclusive if a bootstrap denominator<=epsilon; do not silently drop replicates.

report_also: per-animal MSE/MAE and eligible frame count
calcium amplitude error and correlation with declared handling of flat traces
all confidence intervals and prediction artifacts
kinematic support/coverage and any domain-normalization limitations

primary.comparator: strongest development-CV-selected control, including movement-only release

passive.constant_comparison_interval: Report paired animal95% CI; its lower bound is descriptive, not an additional pass condition for this passive prerequisite.
passive.comparator_for_noninferiority: locked matched nongated comparator; report identity explicitly if gate-off gives identical predictions

biological_acceptance.interpretation: All limits are conjunctive. Passing supports out-of-cohort predictive generalization of the stated phenomenological model, not receptor parameter identification or a causal discovery.

mechanistic_assumption_bridge.status: pending; normalized movement-proxy/calcium fit is not a spike-event calibration
mechanistic_assumption_bridge.not_required: Unique identification of biological9A spike rates from calcium alone is not required and is not claimed.
required: Declare units and a reproducible mapping from measured/engineered input to9A spike event rates, including spontaneous rate, gain, stochastic process and uncertainty/assumption ranges.

Fit/calibrate scale and observation model only on development observations; test the complete spike-event-to-release-to-calcium pipeline on sealed confirmation, not just the normalized proxy surrogate.
Account for the distinction between normalized lowpass movement in[0,1] and an unnormalized sum of event impulses. Do not copy proxy beta directly into the spike gate.
Report nonidentifiability/sensitivity across plausible input-rate and calcium-kernel assumptions; do not label an engineering calibration measured receptor conductance.
Use the exact event-driven release equation in integration. Verify raw hook spikes remain distinct from release-weighted transmission and no actuator-command attenuation shortcut is used.
Confirm dt convergence with the same event times and rate-normalized input generation; virtual receptor blockade and targeted gate-input removal must remain separate controls.
mechanistic_assumption_bridge.bridge_equivalence_check: The promoted candidate must be the same locked spike-to-observation model that passed confirmation. If the final heldout evaluates only a proxy model, biological pass is conditional and this bridge remains pending.
mechanistic_assumption_bridge.dynamic_convergence_acceptance: Across1ms,.5ms,.25ms timesteps with identical event times, transmitted event mass and release trajectories at shared timestamps differ by<=1% of their declared reference scale; document interpolation/event alignment.

anatomical_acceptance.status: corrected cross-version mapping supports an isolated probe; motor-compatible inclusion pending
requirements: Lock original MANC IDs, crosswalk, side/nerve/class correspondence, measured nonzero edges and source hash; homology is not direct receptor measurement.
Use relevant foreleg homologs with explicit inclusion boundaries; do not present all-leg hook circuitry as a calibrated foreleg sensor.
Preserve measured connection counts and frozen internal weights; route only approved9A-to-hook edges away from somatic current to avoid double counting.
Document how newly included cells obtain inputs and reach downstream motor populations. Missing pathways cannot be silently supplied with invented anatomical synapses.

candidate_isolation.training_gate: Biological+bridge+anatomical+isolation evidence all passed and hashes current; otherwise no candidate motor training.
candidate_isolation.training_scope: Train sensory/input and motor/output interfaces on offline demonstrations as needed; anatomical internal weights/counts and release mechanism parameters remain frozen.
candidate_isolation.enable_gate: Separate candidate loader must verify biological/bridge/anatomical reports, candidate graph/checkpoint/runtime hashes and full motor validation; default controller and validated baseline remain available.
candidate_isolation.rollback: Gate-off must exactly restore declared baseline routing and state-reset policy. An expanded candidate graph is not bitwise identical to the original graph, so comparison/rollback must explicitly load the original baseline rather than claim numerical equivalence.

motor_acceptance_after_authorized_traini.base_protocol: At minimum retain all current research/validate_spiking_motor.py acceptance thresholds and heldout fixtures; add targeted gate controls and separate new unseen trajectories.
required: Complete drawing, text, emoji, freehand and all three canonical shapes with contact, tracking, pen-lift, force and stability acceptance.
Demonstrate causal dependence on transmitted neural activity; no runtime teacher, IK, observation-action bypass or per-stroke body reset.
Report full paired baseline/candidate physical results, including perturbations, gate blockade, targeted input removal and all-inhibition removal as distinct interventions.
Preserve old validated checkpoint/runtime hashes; no automatic replacement based solely on lower training error.
motor_acceptance_after_authorized_traini.status: not started; upstream scientific gates pending
